title: MITRE as the place to look for the legacy program

tellings.quote: if you want to look at legacy program stuff, I'd look at MITER.

plain: Jordan Jose, who says he was taken into a secret UFO programme as a child, tells Michels that "if you want to look at legacy program stuff, I'd look at MITRE." The "legacy program" is the name for a supposed long-running secret effort to recover and study non-human craft, and MITRE is a nonprofit that runs research centers for the US government. He says it as advice on where the programme might be found, without explaining further.
